title: GenApp Policy-Issue landing record
description: One landed GenApp Policy-Issue record. The record is the post-chain COMMAREA of a single successful execution of the LGAPOL01, LGAPDB01 and LGAPVS01 chain, decoded by modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py and written as one JSON object on a single line terminated by one line feed. The landed bytes are exactly the ASCII-escaped serialisation of the object followed by one line feed, holding the 17 keys in the order of the required list below: one line, no pretty-printing, no leading or surrounding whitespace, no carriage return, no absent or repeated terminal line feed, and no repeated member name. modernization/landing/land_to_s3.py checks those bytes before the upload and modernization/landing/load_local.py checks them again after the download, and each rejects a document that differs. The landing and raw contracts carry successful extractions only: return_code is 00 on every landed record, and a returned COMMAREA carrying one of the other codes the chain sets - 70, 80, 90, 98 or 99 - is refused by the extractor with its own exit status and is never landed, so no failure row reaches raw.genapp_policy_issue or either canonical relation. The chain's failure evidence stays in the harness captures. The object is landed under the S3 key prefix this contract fixes, landing/source_system_key=<source_system_key>/entity=policy_issue/extract_date=YYYY-MM-DD/part-0000.json; modernization/landing/partition-layout.md, which will also record that prefix, is a planned deliverable and is not present at this milestone. The record is loaded into the all-VARCHAR relation raw.genapp_policy_issue. The record carries exactly 17 keys, in the order fixed by the landing.field_order block of modernization/extraction/copybook_field_map.yml: the warehouse-assigned source_system_key and the 16 runtime business values the chain produces. Every value is a JSON string or null and no value is a JSON number or boolean; all typing is applied by the downstream dbt models. The two date fields and the timestamp field additionally carry semantic format assertions, which modernization/landing/land_to_s3.py and modernization/landing/load_local.py apply by building the validator with a format checker, so a calendar-invalid value is refused by both tools. Field names, order, nullability and byte layout follow modernization/extraction/copybook_field_map.yml, which is the naming authority for this contract. The place this contract occupies in the bridge is shown by Figure 2 — AFTER (BUILT): Canonical Warehouse Bridge in modernization/docs/architecture.md.

source_system_key.title: Source-system key
source_system_key.description: Source-system discriminator assigned by the extraction run. This is the sole warehouse-assigned column of the landed record: no COBOL item supplies it and its evidence is the user requirement rather than a source locator. The value is written unchanged to this record, to the S3 key prefix and to the source_system_key column of canonical.issued_policy and canonical.preissued_rating, both typed VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL. The run value is resolved by modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py from its --source-system-key option, then the SOURCE_SYSTEM_KEY environment variable, then its built-in default; this schema fixes the accepted shape only and pins no particular value. Accepted characters are ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot and hyphen, in 1 to 64 characters.

policy_number.title: Policy number
policy_number.description: Policy number recovered after the policy insert. Source: CA-POLICY-NUM PIC 9(10), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:35, COMMAREA bytes 19-28. The value exists only in the returned COMMAREA: the policy insert supplies DEFAULT for POLICYNUMBER at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:279, IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL() loads the integer host variable DB2-POLICYNUM-int at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:308-310, and the recovered value is moved into the COMMAREA item at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:311. Landed as an unsigned digit string with leading zeros stripped; typed BIGINT NOT NULL in both canonical relations. It is required and never null on a landed record: a blank or all-zero window on a record whose return code is 00 is refused by modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py, and the pattern below admits no leading zero and no zero value. It therefore forms the natural key (source_system_key, policy_number) that both raw loaders and both canonical relations key on.

policy_type.title: Policy type
policy_type.description: Single-letter product discriminator. This is not a COMMAREA item: modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py derives the letter from the trimmed CA-REQUEST-ID using the request routing of the EVALUATE at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:184-207, in which 01AEND yields E, 01AHOU yields H, 01AMOT yields M and 01ACOM yields C. The Db2-side declaration is DB2-POLICYTYPE PIC X, base/src/lgpolicy.cpy:43, set at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:188, 192, 196 and 200 and passed to the policy insert at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:283. Typed CHAR(1) in both canonical relations. A request id EVALUATE does not route is answered with return code 99 at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:204 and no letter is assigned; modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py refuses to land such a record, so every landed record carries one of the four letters and this property admits no null. With this value null no product overlay is selected, so every product premium below is null and payment_amount is the only amount read from its window.

customer_number.title: Customer number
customer_number.description: Customer number supplied in the request. Source: CA-CUSTOMER-NUM PIC 9(10), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:12, COMMAREA bytes 9-18; moved to the integer host variable DB2-CUSTOMERNUM-int at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:176 and passed to the policy insert at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:280. Landed as an unsigned digit string with leading zeros stripped; typed BIGINT in canonical.issued_policy.

request_id.title: Request id
request_id.description: Request identifier the chain routes on. Source: CA-REQUEST-ID PIC X(6), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:10, COMMAREA bytes 1-6; evaluated at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:184. Landed with surrounding spaces trimmed and never null: the chain routes on it. The value is one of the four add-policy request ids the routing EVALUATE recognises at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:184-207 - 01AEND at :188, 01AHOU at :192, 01AMOT at :196 and 01ACOM at :200 - which the enum below fixes. Any other id reaches the WHEN OTHER branch at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:202-205, which sets return code 99 and returns without assigning a policy type, and modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py refuses to land such a record. Typed VARCHAR(6) in canonical.issued_policy, which retains rows carrying 00.

return_code.title: Return code
return_code.description: Return code read from the returned COMMAREA. Source: CA-RETURN-CODE PIC 9(2), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:11, COMMAREA bytes 7-8. Carried as a two-character zero-padded string and never converted to an integer, so the leading zero is preserved. The chain's observed values are 00 success, set at base/src/lgapol01.cbl:105 and base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:293; 70 policy insert returned SQLCODE -530, set at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:296; 80 VSAM write response was not normal, set at base/src/lgapvs01.cbl:144; 90 SQL failure, set at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:301, 390, 428, 474 and 548; 98 COMMAREA shorter than the required length, set at base/src/lgapol01.cbl:114 and base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:211; and 99 unsupported request id, set at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:204 and 239. This contract admits the single value 00: the other five codes are refused by modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py before anything is written, so a record carrying one of them is not a landing record and validates against nothing here. Typed CHAR(2) NOT NULL in canonical.issued_policy, which therefore holds issued policies only.

issue_date.title: Issue date
issue_date.description: Policy issue date supplied in the request. Source: CA-ISSUE-DATE PIC X(10), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:38, COMMAREA bytes 29-38; Db2-side declaration DB2-ISSUEDATE PIC X(10), base/src/lgpolicy.cpy:46; passed to the policy insert as a character host variable at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:281. Landed trimmed as a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD; a window holding only spaces lands as null. The pattern below admits months 01 to 12 and days 01 to 31 only, and the format keyword names the RFC 3339 full-date production; a date that passes both and still names no day of that month, the 30th of February and the 29th of a February outside a leap year among them, is refused by modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py before the record is written, which is the authoritative calendar gate. Typed DATE in canonical.issued_policy.

expiry_date.title: Expiry date
expiry_date.description: Policy expiry date supplied in the request. Source: CA-EXPIRY-DATE PIC X(10), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:39, COMMAREA bytes 39-48; Db2-side declaration DB2-EXPIRYDATE PIC X(10), base/src/lgpolicy.cpy:47; passed to the policy insert as a character host variable at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:282. Landed trimmed as a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD; a window holding only spaces lands as null. The pattern below admits months 01 to 12 and days 01 to 31 only, and the format keyword names the RFC 3339 full-date production; a date that passes both and still names no day of that month is refused by modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py before the record is written, which is the authoritative calendar gate. Typed DATE in canonical.issued_policy.

last_changed.title: Last changed timestamp
last_changed.description: Policy last-changed timestamp read back after the policy insert. Source: CA-LASTCHANGED PIC X(26), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:40, COMMAREA bytes 49-74; Db2-side declaration DB2-LASTCHANGED PIC X(26), base/src/lgpolicy.cpy:48. The insert writes CURRENT TIMESTAMP at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:284 and the assigned value is read back into the COMMAREA item by the SELECT keyed on the recovered policy number at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:316-321, so the value exists only in the returned COMMAREA. modernization/extraction/extract_commarea.py normalises the returned 26-character timestamp to ISO-8601 with a T separator and microsecond precision, written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffff in 26 characters. The pattern below admits months 01 to 12, days 01 to 31, hours 00 to 23 and minutes and seconds 00 to 59 only; the value carries no UTC offset, so no format keyword asserts it and the genapp-timestamp format assertion, which modernization/landing/land_to_s3.py and modernization/landing/load_local.py apply through a checker parsing that exact 26-character representation, holds the value to the calendar and the clock, and that extractor applies the same parse before the record is written. The value is required and is never null on a landed record: the chain reads it back from the POLICY row after the insert, and a blank window is refused. Typed TIMESTAMP NOT NULL in canonical.issued_policy.

broker_id.title: Broker id
broker_id.description: Broker identifier supplied in the request. Source: CA-BROKERID PIC 9(10), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:41, COMMAREA bytes 75-84; Db2-side declaration DB2-BROKERID PIC 9(10), base/src/lgpolicy.cpy:49; moved to the integer host variable DB2-BROKERID-int at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:264 and passed to the policy insert at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:285. Landed as an unsigned digit string with leading zeros stripped; typed BIGINT in canonical.issued_policy.

brokers_reference.title: Broker's reference
brokers_reference.description: Broker's reference supplied in the request. Source: CA-BROKERSREF PIC X(10), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:42, COMMAREA bytes 85-94; Db2-side declaration DB2-BROKERSREF PIC X(10), base/src/lgpolicy.cpy:50; passed to the policy insert as a character host variable at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:286. Landed trimmed, so the value holds at most the 10 characters the PICTURE declares and a window holding only spaces lands as null rather than as an empty string. Typed VARCHAR(10) in canonical.issued_policy.

payment_amount.title: Payment amount
payment_amount.description: Policy payment amount supplied in the request. Source: CA-PAYMENT PIC 9(6), base/src/lgcmarea.cpy:43, COMMAREA bytes 95-100; Db2-side declaration DB2-PAYMENT PIC 9(6), base/src/lgpolicy.cpy:51; moved to the integer host variable DB2-PAYMENT-int at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:265 and passed to the policy insert at base/src/lgapdb01.cbl:287. The MOVE applies no arithmetic and the value is inserted unchanged. The declaration is an unsigned DISPLAY numeric without an implied decimal, so the landed value is a whole number carried as an unsigned digit string with leading zeros stripped; typed DECIMAL(8,2) in canonical.preissued_rating. Carried for every policy type.
